subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. Inside a vast hollow volcanic cone filled by a still lake. A small round hole high overhead admits daylight; it makes a pale patch on the water. The long low spindle-shaped iron Nautilus rests beside a rocky shore, no exterior decks stacked high. View from a ledge looking across.
